arms.B: placement on, score_shipped from the placement-on mapping
arms.C: placement on, score_shipped + w*E, E on the STEP-2 scale (PLACEMENT_E_NORMALISED), w frozen before the read

freshness.note: a fresh seed range, and the registration checks the graph cache: any hit would mean the read is not fresh

gallery.rule: the fresh scenes themselves: one reference per scene, so the truth is in the gallery and every rival is a different instance of the same construction

interval: paired bootstrap over SCENES, 4000 draws, 2.5/97.5 percentiles
mission: 12 step 6a -- fresh synthetic retrieval, arms A/B/C
multiplicity: one primary; Holm is vacuous here and is reported as such

prediction.why: B changes the MAPPING and nothing else. The score it reports is computed from the correspondence the scorer steered, so when the placement term points the wrong way on a hard pair B can only lose: it pays the cost of a moved mapping without being paid for the evidence that moved it. That is why C, not B, is the arm under test.

primary_contrast: C - A on top-1, paired per query, clustered by SCENE
secondary: C - A per view family (in-plane vs out-of-plane)

shortlist.note: retrieval is conditional on the shortlist and the report says so
shortlist.rule: top 8 of the 12 fresh references by the node-similarity shortlist score (M12 step 5), recall reported with the read

verdict_rule: DETECTED iff the scene-clustered interval excludes zero in the pre-registered direction; a detected effect below the design MDE is labelled possibly inflated (Type M)
